name: Fireface 800
author: spoitras
description: Turn the RME Fireface 800 audio stack on and off from the Omarchy bar, with live jackd/FFADO status.

barWidget.description: On/off switch for jackd + FFADO, with sample rate, buffer, DSP load, and xrun count.

schema.label: ff800 command
schema.description: Looked up with ~/.local/bin prepended to PATH. Use an absolute path if it lives elsewhere.

schema.label: Interface off the FireWire bus
schema.description: Hide takes the widget out of the bar entirely while the FF800 is powered off.
